diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3.3 V, datasheet reading 4.5 V
diffs.evidence: The model describes the module, not the bare chip. The vendor listing for this exact 6-digit 0.36" TM1637 module states "Driver IC: TM1637 ... Display size: 76x19 mm ... Voltage: 3.3-5V". The 4.5 V figure is the bare-chip characterisation in the TM1637 V2.4 datasheet ("Electrical character (Ta = -40 - +85 C, VDD = 4.5 - 5.5 V)", typical VDD 5 V), which part.json already states in its description and VCC pin note. Running below 4.5 V is undervoltage and cannot damage the part; vmax 5.5 V matches both sources.
